race.comment: PANDA DRUM (4) brings the most persuasive winning case after scoring in a BM55 at Emerald, where he led and held Final Comment by a nose. The return of Chris Whiteley is a clear plus given their two-from-two record together, and his broader season profile is strong enough to absorb a small query coming back to 1400m. MAKANUI (2) has been highly consistent, with two recent thirds at BM60 and BM55 level, and his record at this venue gives him a solid hope despite rising from picnic company. MAYOR OF KINGSTON (7) was beaten as favourite at Ewan but has placed four times from five starts this season and returns to a more suitable 1400m set-up. CRYPTOLOGY (6) backs up quickly after a Richmond Qld placing and keeps producing honest minor-money form. Include in multiples.
